# Cburnett chess pieces

The twelve SVGs in `assets/pieces/` are the established **Cburnett** chess-piece set by **Colin M. L. Burnett**, as distributed by Lichess. The SVG bytes are unmodified. Only the filenames are mapped from the upstream mixed-case piece names (for example, `wK.svg`) to this application's lowercase names (`wk.svg`). Their original `0 0 45 45` viewBoxes are preserved.

## Source

- Repository: <https://github.com/lichess-org/lila>
- Pinned commit: `5b44d719ec5913dd62aa965f4b8d21e60a00c2c1`
- Piece directory: <https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/5b44d719ec5913dd62aa965f4b8d21e60a00c2c1/public/piece/cburnett>
- Upstream attribution and license: <https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/5b44d719ec5913dd62aa965f4b8d21e60a00c2c1/COPYING.md>
- Author: <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Cburnett>

`manifest.json` records every upstream filename, exact download URL, installed path, byte count, and SHA-256 digest. The SVGs themselves are the complete editable source artwork; no build step is required.
